systemMessage: Set up by yrProject.sh (yrProject v0.5.1; parts: rules, yrIssues). To check or update the setup, ask the agent. Before you change its files, read .yrProject/README.md.

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: This project was set up by yrProject.sh (yrProject v0.5.1; parts: rules, yrIssues); the user saw a one-line notice about it. .yrProject/README.md lists the files that the tool installed, and tells who changes each one. Read it before you change AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/settings.json, a file in .claude/skills/, or the docs guides. Do not edit the tool's blocks in AGENTS.md and README.md, or the files in .yrProject/: "yrProject.sh update" writes them again. When the user asks to check, update or migrate the yrProject setup, or about the list of yrProjects, follow the yrProject skill (.claude/skills/yrProject/SKILL.md); the user does not need to know the commands. The word "project" alone does not mean the yrProject setup: unless the user says yrProject or it is obvious, ask what they mean.
